scientific_question: Do MISSED BassDI events retain measurable event-blind spectro-temporal evidence corresponding to the four already-established Bass-associated attack characteristics?

prior_authority.frozen_directions: Bass-associated means lower values separately for attack spectral centroid, bandwidth, flatness and high/low spectral balance; prior effects are context only, never thresholds.

controlled_mix.reconstruction: unchanged committed mix.py and checksum-frozen ten input authorities; exact replay permitted because preserved WAV is unavailable

event_blind_input: checksum-verified controlled mix only; BassDI samples participate solely as undifferentiated mix summands during deterministic reconstruction

continuous_representation.decode: soundfile float64; arithmetic stereo mean; no normalization, filtering, alignment or resampling
continuous_representation.epsilon: max(float64 tiny, median strictly positive representation power times 1e-12)
continuous_representation.trajectory_geometry: At every complete anchor frame permitting the full [0,0.075) second future interval, retain the median across frame-start coordinates in that interval.

dimensions.attack_spectral_bandwidth: power-weighted population standard deviation around centroid over 20-8000 Hz
dimensions.attack_spectral_flatness: geometric-mean power divided by arithmetic-mean power over 20-8000 Hz

continuous_representation.preservation: Preserve every continuous four-dimensional node with anchor frame/sample and availability. Preserve the complete underlying STFT power representation externally under JGA_EXTERNAL_ROOT with filename, size, SHA-256, schema, role, location and scientific fingerprint authority in Git.

pre_gt_firewall: Before frozen BassDI observation coordinates, PRESERVED/MISSED labels, correspondence and negative coordinates must not be opened or used during representation construction, debugging, replay, fingerprinting or PRE-GT commit. The committed evaluation authority file may be named and checksum-bound without opening its contents.

outcome_authority.population_reuse: Reuse its frozen BassDI PRESERVED, MISSED and deterministic NEGATIVE coordinates exactly; do not derive or modify correspondence.

evaluation.event_window: For each frozen coordinate, nodes with anchor frame-start within inclusive +/-0.050 seconds; no temporal correction.
evaluation.endpoint: Minimum available continuous value in the event window separately for each dimension, because all four prior Bass-associated directions are lower; ties retain earliest anchor. Null with explicit reason if no node.
evaluation.orientation: Negative delta/AUC below 0.5 means first population is lower and thus directionally Bass-associated.
evaluation.uncertainty: 95 percent percentile bootstrap CI for Cliff's delta; 2000 deterministic independent-population resamples; NumPy PCG64 seed 20260902 plus dimension and comparison ordinal.
evaluation.negative_role: source-specificity control only; never optimization, training or threshold authority

decision_rule_priority.INDETERMINATE: Any checksum, authority, firewall, representation, external preservation, replay, PRE-GT commit, outcome-authority, correspondence/evaluation replay invariant fails; or any PRESERVED/MISSED dimension has below 80 percent availability.
decision_rule_priority.EVENT_BLIND_TIMBRAL_EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED: At least three of four MISSED-versus-NEGATIVE Cliff's deltas are <= -0.147 with 95 percent CI wholly below zero, and none of the four MISSED-versus-NEGATIVE deltas is positive.
decision_rule_priority.EVENT_BLIND_TIMBRAL_EVIDENCE_PARTIAL: SUPPORTED is not met and one or two dimensions meet that same negative-effect condition.
decision_rule_priority.SOURCE_ATTRIBUTION_INDETERMINATE: No dimension meets that condition and at least three MISSED-versus-NEGATIVE dimensions have absolute delta <0.147 or an interval containing zero.

interpretation: Continuous timbre-compatible evidence is not Bass identity. Frozen separated-bass unavailability limits this experiment to observability in the controlled mix.
firewalls: no Bass recognition or source identity in a mixture
replay: Two fresh-process acquisitions and two fresh-process evaluations must be byte-identical in canonical scientific content and fingerprints; runtime and external absolute root excluded.
protocol_fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of jq -cS JSON after deleting protocol_fingerprint, including one trailing LF
